---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Walkscope
title: '[FEAT]: '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the suggested enhancement or capability.

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the limitation or challenge is. *E.g., I'm always frustrated when [...]*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it aligns with Walkscope's explainable route context principles.

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Ethical & Privacy Alignment
- [ ] Does this maintain Walkscope's zero-telemetry boundary?
- [ ] Does this avoid subjective "safety" scores in favor of verifiable data density?
- [ ] Does it respect upstream open data fair-use guidelines (OSM/Overpass/Panoramax)?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
